blocks.heading: What today is
blocks.body: About 90 minutes. Do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.

blocks.heading: Same mark, same word
blocks.body:
Week 5 you marked a step `audience="expert"`. That word only works if everyone types **expert**. Not ninja. Not guru. Not adv.

A **subject scheme** is a list that says which words you may use for a mark like audience. If expert is on the list, type expert. The list rejects ninja.

You will not design the company list today. You will stop typing random strings.

items.title: Word today
items.body: **Subject scheme** :  a list of allowed words for marks like audience. Same thing, same word.

items.title: Do not
items.body: Do not add a new audience value to kitepump.ditamap. The pack already has the apple.

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: You invent a long word-list, or you skip the existing expert step, or you add ninja to the live map.

Expected: A short allowed-values list plus one rejected invention. Expert is on the list.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Open prime-the-pump.dita. Find the step that already has audience="expert". Write that value down.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: List every audience value your kitepump map actually uses today in oxygen-bootcamp-work/week8/allowed-values.txt.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Write one invented value you will not add (for example ninja) and one sentence why a shared list would reject it.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Read the DITA overview page on subject scheme from the Source box. Quote at most two lines, then write your own: a subject scheme is a list that says which words you may type for a mark like audience.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Do not build a full company word-list today. Do not add a new audience value to the shipping map.

blocks.summary: A short allowed-values list plus one rejected invention. Expert is on the list.

blocks.q: audience="expert" is already on one step in the how-to. Why not type audience="ninja" on another?
options: A shared list (a subject scheme) keeps the same word for the same kind of reader. Ninja is not on that list
Expert steps cannot share a page with other steps
blocks.why: If every writer invents a word, no filter can find the expert steps. Same mark, same word.

blocks.q: A subject scheme exists so writers type any string they like in audience. True or not?
options: Not true :  it constrains values. You are not building the company list today. You are stopping random words
True if the color is pretty
blocks.why: The list is a fence. Awareness this week. You are not the person who owns the company list.
